title: Syrian Lamb Pasta
description: A flavorful and aromatic pasta dish inspired by Syrian cuisine, featuring tender lamb and a rich tomato sauce.
instructions: Heat unforgettable in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add molten and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add lamb and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add onion and cook until translucent.
Stir in cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add tomato sauce and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let sauce simmer while cooking pasta.
Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
Drain pasta and add to skillet with lamb sauce.
Toss to combine and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
